app.name: Zohaan Motors
app.tagline: Used car operations, built for the UAE.
app.footnote: Inventory, workshop, sales, and documents in one showroom workspace.

common.comingSoon: This module is ready for a later phase.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password issued for your showroom account.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: We will email a reset link if the account exists.
forgot.success: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Use at least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters and a number.
reset.success: Password updated. You can sign in with it now.
reset.waiting: Open the reset link from your email to continue.

mfa.title: Authenticator
mfa.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.enrollDescription: Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the first code to finish.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm the email address before signing in.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Supabase is not configured yet. Add the project URL and anon key.
errors.session: The reset session expired. Request a new link.

validation.phone: Enter a valid UAE phone number.
validation.currency: Enter an amount of zero or more.
